**3. Bias summary**

- Call volume: **652,083** contracts across 38 kept strikes
- Put volume: **388,168** contracts across 31 kept strikes
- Put/call volume ratio: **0.6** → overall tag **CALL**

- **Concentration caveat —
- the CALL tag is low-confidence.** The top 3 call rows alone carry **65.1% of all call volume** (NVDA 217.5 (277,203), IWM 271 (75,315), AAPL 342.5 (71,753)), and all three expire **today**.
- Same-day/0DTE flow is substantially index- and mechanical-driven, so it is not a clean read on directional institutional intent. Strip those three and the picture is materially flatter.

What survives the caveats:

- **Genuine near-ATM call flow, real size:** NVDA call 217.5 expiring today — 277,203 contracts against OI 7,844 (V/OI 35.3, +1.6% ITM) is the single largest credible line in the set.
- IWM calls 270–272 exp 10-19 cluster tightly at the money (V/OI 40–62, OI 185–257).
- TLT calls 80/80.5 exp 10-23 carry the largest OI in the whole scan (10,682 / 7,051) at modest V/OI ~4–5 — real but not unusual.
- **The heavy put volume is mostly deep-ITM closing flow, not bearish conviction:** AAPL puts 195/200 exp 10-23 sit ~42% ITM (19,000 and 9,500 contracts) on OI of ~148, and NVDA put 105 sits −51% ITM on 26,309 contracts.
- Deep-ITM puts trading heavily against tiny open interest are closing or exercise-related, **not** a −42% view on the name.
- **Near-ATM put flow is genuinely thin:** the only OTM put with any size is AAPL put 360 exp 10-23 (5,727 contracts, OI 71, +4.8% OTM) —
- still below the OI floor. There is no clean large-OI bearish cluster in this Pass B set.
